output.question: Where can I find Target's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Target's latest annual report listed on its Investor Relations archive is the 2025 Annual Report. You can read the digital report at https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/2025-annual-report or download the PDF directly at https://corporate.target.com/getmedia/79214b4b-6331-4b1c-b76f-acff121b40f9/2025-Annual-Report-Target-Corporation.pdf.

key_facts.fact: Target's Investor Relations archive identifies the 2025 annual report as the latest report listed and links to both its digital version and PDF download.
The digital report is titled "2025 Annual Report Target Corporation."
The direct PDF download is named "2025-Annual-Report-Target-Corporation.pdf."

passages.quote: Target's annual report includes the 10-K filing (also accessible from SEC Filings) and is available in PDF or digital format.

caveats: The archive page does not display a publication date for the 2025 report; "latest" here means the newest report listed by Target on the page accessed on November 11, 2026.
